info.title: ClickUpfy
info.summary: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to manage ClickUp Sprints, tasks, Docs and time tracking.
info.description: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to manage ClickUp Sprints, tasks, Docs and time tracking. Without arguments it opens the TUI; "clickupfy mcp" starts the MCP server over stdio; any other command runs as a CLI with text or --json output.

command.name: clickupfy
command.description: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to manage ClickUp Sprints, tasks, Docs and time tracking.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help for the current command and exit with code 0.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the version and exit with code 0.

options.name: --json
options.description: Return JSON output with the envelope { ok, command, data } or { ok, command, error }. Errors are JSON too.

options.name: --skill
options.description: Print the full documentation embedded in the binary, written for AI agents. With a topic, print only that section.

options.name: --opencli
options.description: Print the OpenCLI description (JSON) of the whole command tree.

options.name: --account
options.description: ClickUp profile to use. Defaults to PROMOVAWEB_CLICKUPFY_ACCOUNT, then to the active profile.

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI colors in text output. Same as NO_COLOR=1.
